notes:
{設定|せってい} is a verbal noun meaning to set up, configure, or establish. Functions as both noun and suru-verb.

USAGE:
1. Settings/configuration (technical): options on devices or software
2. Setting (creative): time, place, circumstances of a story

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {設定|せってい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up, configure
- {設定|せってい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to change settings
- {設定|せってい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to check settings

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧{設定|せってい}: default settings
- {設定|せってい}⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: settings screen
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧{設定|せってい}: goal setting
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧{設定|せってい}: price setting

Note: Very common in technology contexts. The creative "setting" meaning is used when discussing stories, games, or films.
